# SNDK — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q3 FY2026 earnings printed 2026-04-30. The next scheduled catalyst is Q4 FY2026 earnings (date not yet confirmed; expected late July to early August 2026 per quarterly cadence). Other tracked items include the QLC Stargate datacenter SSD launch, execution of the newly authorized $6B buyback, and the May–June 2026 sell-side conference circuit (source: SanDisk IR; businesswire 2026-04-30).

> _This is bootstrap context dated 2026-05-01. The runtime swing routine must do its own fresh research and indicator analysis; do not anchor to anything stated here._

## Upcoming events

- **Q4 FY2026 earnings:** Date not yet officially scheduled; expected late July to early August 2026 based on quarterly cadence (source: SanDisk IR — needs confirmation once company posts the date).
- **QLC Stargate datacenter SSD launch / ramp:** Management referenced readiness for ramp in coming quarters during the Q3 FY2026 call (source: Q3 transcript via Motley Fool).
- **$6B share buyback execution:** Authorized 2026-04-30; pace of repurchase disclosed quarterly (source: SanDisk Q3 FY2026 release).
- **Sell-side conference circuit (May–June 2026):** _pending — to be filled after first run_ (typical conferences include BofA Tech, Bernstein Strategic Decisions).
- **Any incremental hyperscaler contract announcements:** No date; track as ad-hoc disclosures.

## Recent news synthesis (events only)

- **2026-04-30 — Q3 FY2026 results released:** Revenue $5.95B (+251% YoY, +97% QoQ), GAAP diluted EPS $23.03, GAAP gross margin 78.4% vs 22.5% YoY (source: businesswire / SanDisk IR).
- **2026-04-30 — Datacenter segment disclosure:** Datacenter revenue $1.47B (+233% QoQ, +645% YoY); enterprise SSD revenue +233% sequentially (source: SanDisk Q3 FY2026 release).
- **2026-04-30 — Hyperscaler contracts disclosed:** Five multi-year partnerships covering >1/3 of FY27 bit supply; >$11B of enforceable financial guarantees; $42B minimum revenue backlog from the three Q3-signed deals (source: Q3 transcript, stocktitan).
- **2026-04-30 — Capital structure update:** $6B buyback authorized; zero net debt; $3.74B cash; $2.99B FCF in the quarter (source: businesswire).
- **2026-05-01 — Sell-side price target updates:** Goldman Sachs $700 → $1,200; Bernstein $1,250 → $1,700; Citi maintains Buy at $1,300 (source: Public.com forecast page).
- **2026-04-29 — Bearish sell-side note:** 24/7 Wall Street published a piece arguing ~32% downside risk into year-end (source: 247wallst.com).

## Insider activity

Aggregate ~$7.3M in insider sales across 20 recent Form 4 filings; no recent open-market insider buys. Composition: CEO David Goeckeler 1,569 shares withheld at $632.38 (Feb 25, RSU tax); CTO Alper Ilkbahar 566 shares withheld at $632.38 (RSU tax); director Suzuki Miyuki 3,500 shares sold at $627.53 under lock-up exception; director Thomas Caulfield gifted 29,000 shares for estate planning (source: OpenInsider, stocktitan, stoxpulse).

## Analyst consensus (data, not interpretation)

Coverage: 21 analysts (yfinance) / 18 analysts (Public.com — different cutoff dates). Consensus rating: Buy. Mean price target ~$1,099–$1,206 depending on source. PT range: low $650–$660, high $1,800 (Bernstein) (source: yfinance, Public.com, MarketBeat, WallStreetZen, 2026-05-02).

## Last updated

2026-05-01 — bootstrap from cohort add; one trading day after Q3 print.

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d).
